Dear Madam,

[I](/person/379) have today paid to your credit with [Hoare & Co](/organisation/169) - £200 – as arranged for the [“Dove”](/book/62).

[Mr Macmillan](/person/939) has just left, and he asked me to say that a copy has been today sent to [Lt.

Col.

Hall](/person/2429). I am glad to say that we have had a very good start

Yours faithfully

Geo Lillie [Craik](/person/379)

Miss Yonge

&nbsp;

&nbsp;
